reviews.x: I have long, thick hair and wasn't sure these would even work.  I've used other products and within days, they break.  I use them for putting my hair up to style.  I've been using the first one out of the bag for 2 months now and it's still working great!

I bought these to help with the task of possibly shaving off time doing my hair rountine.  I have very thick and long hair and it became a pain. I would realize I would miss sections of my hair or over did a section of hair, since I didn't have it pinned up.  A dozen come in a pack. I took off one star because they say large and they work...just was expecting a little bigger.  The clamps don't hurt my head which is a plus.

I recently acquired a flat iron and wanted clips like these to section and hold my daughter's hair while we used the flat iron. These are well-made in friendly colors, and they're nicely curved rather than straight. The jaws hold well but aren't too strong. Really an ideal solution and at a great price, too.
These clamps are not sturdy enough for my hair. My hair is extremely thick and these clamps were not strong enough to hold my hair in place.

So I have a lot of hair to the point that it looks thick, nope it's just my density is alive. And it came right before wash day and I was tired of using hair ties to section my hair before, during and after washing. And I must say these butterfly clips are amazing on my hair. It doesn't tug if used correctly. The clips are a little slippy with product on my hand however not that much. And with my natural hair I don't feel as if it's breaking it off. reviews.t: Does not hold a lot of hair, even though ...

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the clips for holding long or thick hair securely in place.
Many customers find them durable and long-lasting, with some noting they still work after months or years of use.
Several reviewers say the clips are great for sectioning hair during styling, washing, or detangling.
A few customers mention the clips are not strong enough for very thick or 4B-type hair.
Some reviewers note the color received differed from the picture or wish more color options were available.

qa.q: Do these clamps hold hair securely without slipping?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree: some say the clamps hold securely, including for thick hair [1][3][5], while one reviewer with extremely thick 4B hair found them not strong enough to hold hair in place [2].

claims.text: The clamps are very secure and hold down very thick hair in place.
The clamps hold thick curly hair nicely.
The jaws hold well but aren't too strong.
For extremely thick 4B hair, the clamps were not strong enough to hold hair in place.

qa.q: Are they durable enough to last through daily use?
qa.answer: Reviews indicate they are durable for daily use: one reviewer says they've stepped on them many times and they're still the same [1], another still has ones from years ago [2], and others report no breakage after months of use [4][5]. However, one reviewer notes other products broke within days but these did not [4], and one 3-star reviewer mentions they can pop off if not careful, though not broken [1].

claims.text: One reviewer says they've stepped on them plenty of times and they are still the same, calling them durable [1].
Another reviewer says they last forever and still has ones bought years ago [2].
A reviewer reports using the first one for 2 months and it's still working great, unlike other products that broke within days [4].
Another reviewer says they haven't broken yet [5].
A 3-star reviewer notes they can pop off if not careful, though not broken [1].

qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.answer: Yes, reviewers describe these clips as a good value and a great price [1][5], and one notes you get plenty of them [4].
